about_the_game:
This pack contains 10 skins. Unlocks an additional and unique skin for each playable character.

Plunder some dungeons like fearless veterans, but with elegance!

Veterans Skins Pack


  • Elian - Marauder
  • Thorgrim - War Master
  • Pod - Minstrel
  • Melinda - Matriarch
  • Thrashkarog - High Priestess
  • Rose - Botanist Expert
  • Odessa - Warrior Queen
  • Franck - Jungle Hermit
  • Anemhutep - Soul Eater
  • Elvire - Paladin of Light
